item.tib: gsang mchog lha sum brgya drug bcu'i bsgrubs gzhung
item.coloph: thugs rje nyi ma'i rgyud mang yang phyi nang gsang gsum la sbyin ba'i mkha' 'gro la sogs khro mo bcu 'byung ba ni phyi rnam par spyod pa'i rgyud do/ rol byed drwa ba la sogs 'byung ba ni nang kun grub rdzogs pa'i rgyud do/ nam mkha'i mdangs ldan ma la sogs 'byung ba ni gsang ba sangs rgyas rgyud du bya'o/ mi lus bsam legs kyi yang (kyis kyang) bsgrubs pa'i bsnyems pa yang gsang gi brgyud do/ spa smar ro//
